entries.good_example:
check_deps() { for cmd in docker git curl; do command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; done; }
check_space() { [[ $(df . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}') -gt 1048576 ]] || exit 1; }
entries.rationale: Deployments often fail due to missing dependencies or disk space mid-process. SS QLM mandates pre-flight checks before any modification to the production environment.
Symlink switching is atomic. If a new release fails, the SS QLM standard requires a single command to point the symlink back to the previous stable release directory.
